## Online Engineering Calculators & Tools
- [Ohm's Law Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/ohms-law-calculator.html): Compute voltage, current, resistance, and electrical power with circuit analysis.
- [Resistor Color Code Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/resistor-calculator.html): Decode 4-band and 5-band standard resistor color values and tolerances.
- [LED Current Limiting Resistor Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/resistor-for-led.html): Calculate series resistor values and power dissipation for LED circuits.
- [Capacitor Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/capacitor-calculator.html): Determine capacitance, RC time constants, reactance, and energy storage.
- [Inductance Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/inductance-calculator.html): Air-core coil inductance, inductive reactance, and resonance calculations.
- [Buck-Boost Converter Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/buck-boost-calculator.html): Design DC-DC switching regulator components, inductor sizing, and duty cycles.
- [Battery Capacity & Runtime Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/battery-capacity-runtime-calculator.html): Battery life estimator with Peukert's law and discharge efficiencies.
- [Battery Solar Sizing Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/battery-solar-calculator.html): Solar panel wattage and battery bank sizing for off-grid IoT deployments.
- [555 Timer Astable & Monostable Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/555-timer-calculator.html): Pulse width, frequency, and duty cycle calculations for NE555 timers.
- [Voltage Divider Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/voltage-divider-calculator.html): Resistor divider outputs with loaded and unloaded circuit modeling.
- [Decibel & dBm RF Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/decibel-dbm-calculator.html): Power and voltage gain in dB, dBm to watts conversion, and cascaded RF stages.
- [Op-Amp Gain Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/op-amp-gain-calculator.html): Inverting, non-inverting, differential, and summing operational amplifier circuits.
- [PCB Trace Width Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/pcb-trace-width-calculator.html): IPC-2221 conductor current capacity, temperature rise, and trace width.
- [Power Factor Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/power-factor-calculator.html): Real, reactive, and apparent power analysis with power factor correction.
- [Power Triangle Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/power-triangle-calculator.html): Apparent power (kVA), active power (kW), and reactive power (kVAR) trigonometry.
- [RC Filter & LC Resonance Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/rc-filter-lc-resonance-calculator.html): Cutoff frequencies, resonant frequencies, and bode response estimations.
- [Transformer Turns Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/transformer-turns-calculator.html): Primary/secondary turns, voltage ratios, and core sizing parameters.
- [Wire Gauge (AWG) Calculator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/wire-gauge-calculator.html): Current capacity, voltage drop, and conductor resistance for wiring.
- [Length & Unit Converter](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/length-converter.html): Engineering unit conversion for imperial and metric dimensions.
- [Electrical Calculation](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/electrical-calculation.html): Comprehensive single-phase and three-phase AC/DC circuit analysis.
- [LCD Custom Character Generator](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/lcd-custom-character-generator.html): 5x8 pixel bitmap matrix designer generating C/C++ byte arrays for HD44780 displays.
- [Linux Commands Reference](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/mastering-linux-commands.html): Command-line reference guide for embedded Linux and system administration.
- [Interactive To-Do List](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/to-do-list.html): Client-side productivity manager with priority tagging and local persistence.
- [Medication Reminder App](https://mohamed-tarek-abdelhady.vercel.app/sites/medication-reminder.html): Standalone schedule manager with audio alerts and compliance history.
